title: Newly Acquired Speeder Bikes
description: Heading back to the Tusken Raider camp, Boba returned on a speeder bike, towing many other bikes behind him. Fett offered the chieftain the bikes as a gift, but the tribesmen began to hack away and dismantle the bikes, not yet understanding the plan or significance of the vehicles. Stopping them, Boba offered to teach them to ride and revealed his plan. To simplify the operation of the bikes for Tusken Raiders, Boba found a familiar activity they could relate to. "Like a bantha," Fett said, hoping the relation would make something click.
